caption: One valid switch state: S2 connects input b to output A, S6 connects c to B, and S7 connects a to C. Each output row has exactly one closed switch; this state also uses each input once.

spec.title: 3×3 switch matrix
spec.aria: A three-by-three table of switches S1 to S9, one row per output phase and one column per input phase, with one closed switch marked in each output row and no two in the same column.
